I had no need for the SU for a long time, but then, just after my 1st year in Trinity, I experienced a very very very bad period of mental health. I was left absolutely floundering because I couldn't sit my exams and progress to 2nd year.

It was pivotal for my recovery to have structure in my life and do what I love, but how could I do that without the prospect of progression in college?! I reached out to the Education Officer, , and he helped me to get a repeat year on medical grounds,

I am so thankful to Dale and the SU, I literally wouldn't be in college without their help. It's impossible for you to predict when you'll need the help of the SU, so don't throw the option away just because you're functioning without it at the moment.
